phases.1: Reliable foundation: ingest, organization, scripts, shot planning, basic editing, audio sync, captions, exports, versioning, quality checks
phases.2: Professional finishing: motion graphics, transitions, color, dialogue repair, music, SFX, compositing, reframing, mastering, platform versions
phases.3: Advanced creation: animation, VFX, tracking, keying, restoration, generative video, specialized genres, high-complexity effects
phases.4: Scale and safety: automation, collaboration, rights, privacy, accessibility, localization, regression checks, delivery manifests, archival
phases.5: Autonomous production: multimodal interpretation, selects, rough cuts, capability routing, repair agents, adaptive compute, approvals, orchestration
